rules.label: 🚀 Stage 2 growth leaders
rules.text: Trend template passes · Stage 2 · sales tier strong or explosive (or steady and accelerating) · strong quarterly and annual EPS (C and A) · ranked by RS rank, ties by scan score · 10 per list, at most 3 per sector.

rules.label: 💎 Capital quality
rules.text: Trend template passes · ROE ≥ 20% · FCF margin > 0% · net debt / EBITDA known and ≤ 1 · ranked by moat score, ties by scan score · 10 per list, at most 3 per sector.

rules.label: 🏷️ Undervalue vs peers
rules.text: On the 🏷️ vs-peers list (P/S at most 50% of the peer median) · TTM revenue ≥ $100M · latest-quarter sales ≥ 20% y/y · TTM growth ≥ 20% · ok liquidity floor · ranked by P/S vs peers · 10 per list, at most 3 per sector.

rules.label: 📈 Bonde
rules.text: Trend template passes · Bonde tier strong or explosive · ranked by Bonde score, ties by scan score · 10 per list, at most 3 per sector.

rules.label: 📉 Fallen growers turning up
rules.text: On the served 📉 page (first 80) · ≥ 40% under the 52-week high · ≥ 10% over the 52-week low · sales ≥ 20% y/y · ok liquidity floor · ranked by sales growth · 10 per list, at most 3 per sector.

rules.label: 🔥 Hot sectors
rules.text: In its group's served top 25 on 🔥 Hottest · sales tier strong or explosive · quarterly EPS y/y > 0% · one-month return > 0% · ranked by one-month return · 10 per list, at most 2 per sector.

rules.label: 🌱 Strong but not moving yet
rules.text: Stage 1 (price not moving yet) · long-term score ranked and ≥ 70 · net profit > $0 · operating cash flow > $0 · sales CAGR ≥ 15% · liabilities / equity ≤ 1 · current sales tier steady, strong or explosive · average daily $ volume ≥ $5M · ≥ 10% under the 52-week high · net debt / EBITDA shown, not a rule · one share class per company · ranked by score · 10 per list, at most 3 per sector.

rules.label: 🔄 Small & mid caps accelerating after a fall
rules.text: Market cap $300M–$10B · sales tier strong or explosive and accelerating · prior-quarter sales > 0% · ≥ 30% under the 52-week high · ≥ 10% over the 52-week low · Stage 1 or 2 · average daily $ volume ≥ $3M · profit shown, not a rule · ranked by sales acceleration · 10 per list, at most 3 per sector.

rules.label: 🧭 Pankaj's long-term list
rules.text: Pankaj's picks and his zones (Agg, C1, C2, C3) from his sheet — not screened, no list cap, no sector cap. The zone read uses the latest closed bar. Pankaj's zones from his sheet, not re-screened. In a zone = the latest closed bar within 0.5% of a zone edge (the /pankaj page's rule).

rules.label: Notices
rules.text: Notices: Stage 2 → Stage 3 or 4 (carried across in-between weeks), a sales tier below its tier at save (declining < weak < steady < strong < explosive), and a 🌱 name moving Stage 1 → Stage 2. Only stage_drop, sales_drop, started_moving may ever ring; a list rule that fails shows ⚠️ here; a price rule that flips is a plain line. Missing data is 'not read', never 'dropped'.

rules.label: Schedule
rules.text: Re-read weekly after the 4:30 PM ET re-rate on the last trading day of the week. The saved list never grows or shrinks; each list's weekly top is shown, not saved.

rules.label: Phone push
rules.text: One phone push per week, only when a saved name dropped or a 🌱 name started moving.

rules.label: Zone reach push
rules.text: Owner only. A name on the private zone list rings once per name, zone and session when a trade from today's session prints inside one of its saved zones (within 0.5% of an edge) and the previous session's close sat outside that zone; a name with no close from the previous session cannot ring. One price snapshot per alerts pass; nothing on a closed day or outside the app's push hours. Phone push on.

rules.label: Forward record
rules.text: Forward record: equal weight across the screened names from the first session's open after 2026-11-12, against RSP and SPY; no number before 21 sessions; then a 95% by-name bootstrap CI (2000 draws) and a random-names placebo (1000 draws) from the same universe.

caveats: None of these lists is a buy signal.
VIR/WAT/KDP sales jumps look like one-offs or acquisitions
